name: bilibili-creator
description: Unofficial Bilibili Open Platform connector for creator metrics, video publishing, and article publishing.

shortDescription.en-US: Track creator metrics and publish videos or articles
shortDescription.zh-CN: 汇总创作数据并发布视频或专栏

longDescription.en-US: Connect an approved Bilibili Open Platform app through OAuth to inspect account and submission data, track follower snapshots, aggregate video playback, and publish videos or Bilibili-compatible articles.
longDescription.zh-CN: 通过 OAuth 连接已审核的哔哩哔哩开放平台应用，读取账号与稿件数据、记录粉丝快照、汇总视频播放量，并发布视频或 B 站兼容的专栏文章。

defaultPrompt: 汇总我的 B 站粉丝数、近 30 天增量和视频播放量
列出最近发布的 B 站视频及其数据
把这个本地视频发布到 B 站

connectors.name: Bilibili Open Platform
connectors.description: Local MCP connector for an authorized Bilibili creator account.
permissions: Stores the Bilibili OAuth client secret and OAuth session in Anybox credential storage.
Sends signed HTTPS requests to Bilibili Open Platform and uploads user-selected local media files.
Reads the authorized account profile, granted scopes, follower counts, submissions, and submission metrics.
Can publish videos and articles when the user explicitly requests publishing.
Can permanently delete a specified video or article only when the destructive tool receives confirm=true.
Stores only numeric metric snapshots under the local Anybox data directory for follower change tracking.

installReview: Requires an approved Bilibili Open Platform application and an associated creator account.
Configure the OAuth callback URL as http://localhost:1455/auth/callback in the Open Platform application.
Request USER_INFO, USER_DATA, ARC_BASE, ARC_DATA, ATC_BASE, and ATC_DATA permissions for the complete V1 tool set.
Publishing uploads user-selected local files and creates content on the connected account.
Delete tools are irreversible and require both explicit user intent and confirm=true.
This integration is unofficial and does not use Bilibili artwork or claim endorsement.
